# coolify_server_settings (Resource)

Singleton settings of a Coolify server: reverse-proxy behaviour, automated Docker cleanup (docs: knowledge-base/server/automated-cleanup), Sentinel monitoring (docs: knowledge-base/server/sentinel) and Cloudflare Tunnel (docs: integrations/cloudflare). Only the blocks you configure are managed; destroying the resource leaves the server's settings as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_server_settings" "worker" {
  server_uuid = coolify_server.example.uuid

  docker_cleanup = {
    frequency             = "0 4 * * *"
    threshold             = 80
    delete_unused_volumes = false
  }

  sentinel = {
    enabled         = true
    metrics_enabled = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_uuid` (String) UUID of the server. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `cloudflare_tunnel` (Attributes) Cloudflare Tunnel (not available on the localhost server). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloudflare_tunnel))
- `docker_cleanup` (Attributes) Automated Docker cleanup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker_cleanup))
- `proxy` (Attributes) Reverse-proxy behaviour. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy))
- `sentinel` (Attributes) Sentinel monitoring agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sentinel))

<a id="nestedatt--cloudflare_tunnel"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloudflare_tunnel`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Mark the server as reached through a Cloudflare Tunnel.


<a id="nestedatt--docker_cleanup"></a>
### Nested Schema for `docker_cleanup`

Optional:

- `delete_unused_networks` (Boolean) Also delete unused networks.
- `delete_unused_volumes` (Boolean) Also delete unused volumes.
- `force_cleanup` (Boolean) Run cleanup on schedule regardless of the threshold.
- `frequency` (String) Cron expression for the cleanup job.
- `threshold` (Number) Disk-usage percentage (1–99) that triggers a cleanup.


<a id="nestedatt--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy`

Optional:

- `generate_exact_labels` (Boolean) Generate exact proxy labels.
- `redirect_enabled` (Boolean) Redirect requests for unknown hosts.
- `redirect_url` (String) URL unknown hosts are redirected to.


<a id="nestedatt--sentinel"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sentinel`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable Sentinel.
- `metrics_enabled` (Boolean) Collect metrics.
- `metrics_history_days` (Number) Days of metrics history to keep.
- `refresh_rate_seconds` (Number) Metrics refresh rate in seconds.
